label: MiniMap
summary: Draws a small map window in the top-right corner during normal play, centred on Alucard's current map square.

MainGame hook: jal func_800E385C(g_CurrentOT) -> jal 0x800E2F3C (minimap draws, then tail-calls func_800E385C)

vanilla.reason: Self-contained: the routine only reads vanilla globals (g_GameState, g_GameEngineStep, g_StageId, castle flag 0x2FB, g_Tilemap, g_PlayerX/Y, g_ClutIds, g_CurrentBuffer), uses its own packet buffers inside the patched range, and replaces debug code that the US game never calls; vanilla bytes equal the off bytes.

overlaps.detail: No byte overlap. The L2-shortcut/Meal-Ticket code cave (and Dark Metamorphosis/Faerie caves) ends at DRA 0x42E7C, just below the minimap at 0x42F3C; both reuse the same unused debug-code area of DRA.

The rest of the Reawakened port (DRA 0x2E300-0x2E358, 0x2EAC0-0x2EB24, 0x5F248, F_GAME.BIN palettes 0x18D/0x18E at 0x411A2-0x411E0, and three hooks in every stage/boss overlay) is the coloured damage-number feature; the minimap does not use any of it.

notes: Ported from Reawakened 2.79 (Track 1 PPF): DRA 0x42F3C-0x43264 is byte-identical to Reawakened. ASS changed only the hook target: Reawakened calls its own dispatcher at 0x800B5858 from 0x800E3DAC, ASS calls the minimap at 0x800E2F3C directly (o/v word 0x0C038E17 -> 0x0C038BCF). Nothing else in a references 0x800E2F3C-0x800E3263 and nothing jumps into it. The routine returns early unless g_GameState==2 (Game_Play), g_GameEngineStep==1, g_StageId!=0x1F (prologue ST0) and castle-flag byte 0x8003C0E7 (flag 0x2FB) is 0; Reawakened toggles that flag from its pause menu, but ASS did not port the toggle, so the minimap is always on. It reads the castle-map image the game keeps in VRAM (CLUT g_ClutIds[0x1C0]), draws a textured quad + a 0x8898A8 polyline frame at screen (0xD7..0xF9, 0x1C..0x3E) and a 3x3 white player dot, double-buffered via two 0x54-byte packet blocks at 0x800E31BC/0x800E3210. Not part of the minimap (identified while checking): F_GAME 0x411A2-0x411E0 = damage-number palettes; LIB 0x135D/0x139D/0x13FD-0x1416 = Librarian shop entry fields (shop edit that happens to equal Reawakened); NZ1 0x238A = one byte of Clock Tower room-table data (0x0C->0x04) copied from Reawakened. Added between image t (09-27) and b (10-01) without a PPF. Not emulator-tested by this research.
